assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_URARAKA_OCHAKO_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its UR-SUP-01 to UR-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Uraraka sections of the Class 1-A character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Uraraka entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. All five are repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42. The readiness index's specialist_ready label and the model's retrospective probe are inputs, not conclusions. The supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit, the deep readings, other characters' models and any anime or V1 material are not curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Uraraka from the V01:p94-181 entrance exam, rescue, point-sharing offer and Deku reframing, through the V02:p101-104 and p194 support of Iida, the V03:p095-099 family motive, the V04:p176-190 individuation and V05:p007-038 Bakugo match and father's call, the V06:p030-031 internship choice, V08:p075-079 and p143-145, V09:p176-181, V11:p201-204, the V12:p056-058 and V13:p024-032 attraction and rescue pages, V15:p057-183 fieldwork, the V22:p169-180 and V23:p015-062 Blackwhip intervention, the V30:p044-077 Toga exchange, V31:p013-019 and p210-213, the V33:p095-169 public advocacy, V35:p041-154, V38:p007-123 and V39:p063-139, to the V42:p095-183 grief, counseling and adult pages, with UR-SUP-01 and UR-SUP-03 profile facts as endpoints. Kept as separable states: early student, internship and license period, joint training and first war, refuge and final war, and adult; later outcomes are not moved earlier. No Class 1-A ledger entry covers V07, V10, V14, V16, V18-V21, V24-V29, V32, V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a persistent priority (making people's lives lighter in materially concrete ways), its ordinary roots in her parents' fatigue and people's relieved faces (UR01, UR03; V03:p095-099, V22:p172), an ideal self (able to help without simply leaning on someone else), a feared self (the inadequate helper, and later the person who lets unrecognized pain disappear behind a public success), a located blind spot (composure that hides her own cost, V42:p110-117) and one governing decision question: what might actually reach the present person without abandoning those at risk. Its context branches are each located: refusing a ready plan against Bakugo (V04:p176-190, V05:p007-031), recruiting Shinso for uncontrolled Blackwhip (V22:p169-180) and containment plus conversation with Toga (V38-V39). UR-V01 found motive supported. Not A: one retrospective, nonblind probe; priorities carry no weights; most branches rest on one situation each. Not C: the model is operational, states regimes to simulate separately and revises earlier readings against located countercases.

The model gives five dated snapshots with controlling distinctions (early school and Sports Festival; internships and license; joint training and first war; U.A. refuge and final war; V42 grief and adult work), and the Class 1-A ledger gives dated deltas for V01-V06, V08-V09, V11-V13, V15, V17, V22-V23, V30-V31, V33, V35, V38-V39 and V42; the readiness index dates each tier change (V03 emerging to moderate, V22 moderate to strong, V33 strong to specialist_ready). The Toga relation is explicitly sequential (fear, objection, curiosity, personal investment, reciprocal gift, grief), and attraction moves from peer-labeled (V12:p056-058) to self-labeled and contained (V13:p024-025) to adult approach (V42:p177-183). Not A: no Class 1-A ledger entry covers V07, V10, V14, V16, V18-V21, V24-V29, V32, V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41, including the whole V24-V29 run, and the adult state rests on a few V42 pages plus supplements. Not C: the central transitions carry located knowledge differences and the model forbids moving later insight earlier.

Located Japanese formulations span family colloquial (私は絶対ヒーローになってお金稼いで 父ちゃん母ちゃんに楽させたげるんだ！, V03:p097-099), public defeat (負けたからって負けてられんよ, V05:p034-038), self-labeled feeling (恋だ and この気持ちは しまっておこう, V13:p024-025), public advocacy (連れ戻したのは私たちです!!, 見えてますか!?, 普通の高校生, V33:p095-111), moral confrontation (やっちゃった事は消えない!!, V30; 故意に人を殺めた事…!! なかった事にはしてあげられない…!! and 私は あなたの笑顔を 見なかった事には したくない!!, V39:p098-105), the ordinary 恋バナ inside lethal containment (V38:p007-021) and adult 私がやりたい事をしてます (V42:p153). The model names 私, デクくん as relation-specific, public/private/urgent differentiation and V39 pages checked in Japanese; UR-V01 found speech and register supported. Not B: there is no honorific or address inventory beyond デクくん, and the model warns against exaggerating a dialect into every sentence without stating which regional features occur where. Not D: many registers are located with recipient and context.

Low-stakes windows: helping an anxious stranger before the exam (V01:p94), the private call with her father (V05:p034-038), the mall approach (V08:p143-145), acting as social bridge for Tsuyu's disclosure and reframing the room contest (V11:p201-204), embarrassment floating while watching training (V12:p056-058), ordinary warmth after containing her feeling (V13:p112), adult peer and counseling pages (V42:p133, p149-155, p169-183), and the profile facts of solitary student living, food preferences and money sent home (UR-SUP-01, profile and editorial). Not C: most windows are short and attraction-, family- or crisis-adjacent, the model states no ordinary-day policy, and domestic life rests on profile facts. Not E: several distinct low-stakes windows are located, and V11 shows ordinary-life relational leadership.

The model's partner table states conditional behavior and what each relation does not license for her parents, Midoriya, Asui and close peers, Bakugo, Toga and adult counseling clients, and the ledgers add located directional deltas: parents (V03:p095-099, V05:p034-038), Midoriya (V01:p94-181, V04:p016-017, p176-190, V08:p075-079, V13:p024-025, V22:p169-180, V23:p015, p061-062, V33:p095-116, V35:p041-057, p141-154, V42:p110-117, p177-183), Bakugo (V05:p007-031), Iida (V02:p101-104, p194), Shinso (V22:p169-180), Tsuyu (V09:p176-181, V11:p201-204, V42:p153-155) and Toga (V09, V30:p044-077, V35, V38, V39:p063-139, V42). UR-V01 found relationship handling supported. Not A: Asui and other peer relations are thin, adult relations rest on V42 pages, and the adult Midoriya relationship status is unstated. Not C: conditioning is explicit, repeated and bounded per partner and per state.

Her inner reasoning is given in her own words or narrated thought at many located points: the family motive (V03:p095-099), realizing that choosing familiar allies had become an easy path (V04:p188-190), the self-label and containment decision (V13:p024-025), the childhood attention memory and the question of who protects heroes (V22:p172-173), 私はあの人の当たり前を知らない (V35:p041-057), the self-narration これが私! だから今 私は ここにいる! (V39:p112-113), her acceptance of Toga's エゴ charge, and grief, self-blame and directly narrated love (V42:p095-117, p177-183). Not A: the long-term grief course and the meaning of the dreams are OPEN, the V30 effect of Toga's response is seen largely from outside, and the V24-V29 interval is unsampled. Not C: central motives and their revision are located in her own words across the series.

Located conflict policy: tactical inference against Kurogiri (V02:p194), an independent debris-field plan against Bakugo continued to her bodily limit (V05:p007-025), refusing Toga's pseudo-intimate frame with Tsuyu (V09:p176-181), entering an uncontrolled power field and recruiting Shinso (V22:p169-180), holding an accountability boundary under Toga's question (V30:p044-077), public responsibility-taking under crowd hostility without promising safety (V33:p095-116), and containment plus conversation with non-harm-directed Zero Gravity (V38:p007-021, V39:p063-124). The model states that physical victory alone leaves the relational problem unresolved and that acute rescue compresses speech. UR-V01 found action partial and motive supported. Not A: the blood offer and propagation were not predicted, combat outside rescue and the Toga line is thin, and V24-V29 is unsampled. Not C: the policy is explicit, conditioned and repeatedly located.

Her own reasons are located across a developing dilemma: accountability stated before reciprocal understanding (V30:p044-077: やっちゃった事は消えない!! and その責任は受け入れなきゃいけない), refusal of a forgive-or-not binary and a named epistemic gap (V35:p041-057), accountability and recognition placed in one decision rule with self-interest admitted (V39:p098-105), and public risk communication that concedes fear (V33:p103-116). The model separates causal understanding, personhood, accountability and permissible force, marks the blood offer exceptional rather than a general duty, and UR-V01 found motive supported. Not A: deliberation outside offender recognition, rescuer care and public advocacy is unsampled, and the probe tests one case. Not C: the reasons are hers, recur and develop over four located occasions with competing considerations named. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

Only local evidence: embarrassment floating (V12:p056-058), the ordinary 恋バナ register used inside lethal containment, which the vocabulary ledger says to keep as casual intimacy (V38:p007-021), a bonus-fiction blurt she regrets (UR-SUP-02) and an attributed wish to laugh together including herself (UR-SUP-03, self-report with gag source class). Not D: none of this establishes how she jokes, teases or plays.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted supplements; the model reports V39 pages checked in Japanese. Not C: the Class 1-A ledger carries no Uraraka entry for 20 of the 42 volumes (V07, V10, V14, V16, V18-V21, V24-V29, V32, V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41), so the evidence set cannot tell whether she is absent or unsampled there; the model has eight evidence atoms; the supplement claims are profile, editorial, bonus-fiction or author-comment sources whose ledger warrants are not curated here; and the artifacts share one authorship. Not E: the sampled volumes include every transition the model treats as pivotal.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs dependence on Midoriya as her total identity and reads her refusal of his plan as individuation (V04:p176-190); the ledger records that V08 attraction evidence does not establish Midoriya's reciprocity; her father releases rather than imposes urgency (V05:p034-038); the model refuses to diagnose the dreams or treat them as a literal Toga vestige, and the ledger calls her self-blame testimony, not a causal verdict (V42:p095-117, p155); non-harm-directed Zero Gravity is a policy, not a guarantee; the blood offer is not a general duty; and V42 profession does not grant unlimited counseling knowledge. The readiness index warns that some historical rows are carry-forward defects. Not B: no independent audit is part of the evidence set.

Entries are page-located by volume with the V31 page convention stated. The model's snapshot table and knowledge gate name the variables to fix before reconstruction (what she knows about Toga, Twice, Midoriya's mission, her own attraction and the present danger) and give explicit leakage checks (no V39 childhood disclosure at V30, no adult dream content at V35); the relationship ledger orders the Toga states and forbids inserting later insight into the first encounter. UR-V01 freezes inputs through V38 with Git blob IDs at a source lock. Not A: twenty volumes are unsampled and in-world dates are not given. Not C: the state boundaries and their knowledge differences are stated, not left to the reader.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers, and UR-V01 found speech supported qualitatively, but there is no honorific or address inventory beyond デクくん, the model warns against over-applying a dialect without stating its features, and it says generated dialogue is an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Uraraka's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early student and Sports Festival (V01-V05), internship and license period (V06-V13), joint training and first war (V22-V31), U.A. refuge and final war (V33-V39), or adult (V42); later insight (the V35 当たり前 question, V39 childhood disclosure, V42 grief and dreams) is not moved earlier.

The interlocutor is her parents, Midoriya, Tsuyu or another Class 1-A classmate, Bakugo, Shinso, Toga in the state the ledgers give, a person in distress or rescue, or an adult counseling client, handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.

The setting is school, a rescue or hero operation, public advocacy, a peer gathering or adult Quirk counseling, with what she knows about Toga, Twice, Midoriya's mission, her own attraction and the present danger stated before any choice is predicted.
Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels; it produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early student (V01-V05), internship and license period (V06-V13), joint training and first war (V22-V31), refuge and final war (V33-V39), or adult (V42), stated explicitly; the unsampled intervals are not used as states.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Parents, Midoriya, Tsuyu or another classmate, Bakugo, Shinso, Toga, a rescue subject or an adult counseling client, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.
setting_constraints: School, rescue or hero operation, public advocacy, peer gathering or adult counseling
Her knowledge of Toga, Twice, Midoriya's mission, her attraction and the present danger stated
No invented romance transaction, domestic routine or postmortem Toga speech

scenario_readiness.note: The model's own conditional reconstruction (adult Ochako with a child who describes an unusual Quirk-related desire and expects disgust) states likely actions, confidence levels and what imminent danger changes, and UR-V01 tests the V38 to V39 recognition case. Together they support narrow novel scenes of rescue, recognition and prevention. The single probe is retrospective and nonblind.

conditions: The setting is low-stakes contact with a classmate, family member or adult peer, with the state named.
Output keeps forward composure in public with more vulnerability only in trusted family or friend settings, warm initiative without dependence, and embarrassment that regulates rather than withdraws.
Domestic routine, leisure and hobbies beyond the profile facts are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Narrowly supported by located windows (V01:p94, V05:p034-038, V08:p143-145, V11:p201-204, V12:p056-058, V13:p112, V42:p133, p149-155, p169-183) and the UR-SUP-01 and UR-SUP-03 profile and attributed facts.

conditions: The dilemma concerns how to treat a person who has caused harm, whether and how to protect an exhausted rescuer, or how to reach someone in danger without abandoning others, with the state and her knowledge stated.
Output keeps accountability and recognition together, admits her own interest rather than claiming neutral procedure, and does not turn the V39 blood offer into a general duty.
Political, institutional-policy and private-family dilemmas are not predicted, and V39 reasoning is not used for a V30 or earlier dilemma.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in V30:p044-077, V33:p103-116, V35:p041-057 and V39:p098-105, with the model's separation of understanding, personhood, accountability and force, support bounded dilemmas of recognition, accountability and rescuer care.

conditions: The partner is Midoriya only, in a named state.
Before V42 the feeling is contained and does not displace professional focus or become possession of his role; at V42 mutual approach is shown without a formal dating or marriage label.
No confession transaction, dating history, reciprocity before the evidence shows it, or other partner is invented.
scenario_readiness.note: Her side of the Midoriya attraction is located and state-bounded: visible fluster (V08:p075-079), peer label she cannot yet own (V12:p056-058), self-label and deliberate containment (V13:p024-025), releasing him to his battlefield (V35:p141-154) and directly narrated adult love with mutual approach (V42:p177-183). The model marks confession details and formal relationship status OPEN.

conditions: The setting is training, licensed rescue or agency fieldwork, public advocacy for a rescuer, or adult Quirk counseling, with the state and her Zero Gravity limits (contact, nausea, training history) stated.

Output preserves concrete help that recruits complementary capability, non-harm-directed use of her Quirk under pressure, and patient trust-building in counseling that does not assume her Toga history explains the client.
Institutional counseling outcomes, unlimited counseling expertise and exact combat outcomes are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located across internship choice and training (V06:p030-031), structural rescue judgment (V13:p032), agency fieldwork under Ryukyu (V15:p057-062, p126-183), emergency intervention (V22:p169-180), mass civilian rescue (V31:p013-019), public advocacy (V33:p095-116) and adult Quirk counseling (V42:p133, p149-155; UR-SUP-03). READY was considered and rejected: no professional choice outside UR-V01's recognition case was tested by a frozen prediction, and adult counseling rests on a few pages, editorial guide facts and one medium-confidence reconstruction.

known_limits.statement: Her money motive is family-directed care (V03:p095-099), and her warmth toward Midoriya is not tactical dependence: she refuses his anti-Bakugo plan and the strategy is credited to her (V04:p176-190; V05:p031).
Her father explicitly releases her from hurrying to help the family (V05:p034-038); parental pressure is not invented where the source releases it.

Attraction is peer-labeled before she owns it (V12:p056-058), self-labeled and contained at V13:p024-025, and shown as mutual approach only at V42:p177-183; Midoriya's reciprocity is not licensed before that, and early embarrassment does not imply an adult commitment.

Fear, moral objection, curiosity, explicit personal investment, reciprocal gift and grief are sequential states of the Toga relation (V09, V30, V35, V38, V39, V42); later insight is not inserted into an earlier encounter.
Recognition of Toga never retracts accountability for intentional killings (V30:p044-077; V39:p098-105); she rejects wholesale affirmation of harm.
The V39 offer of her blood is exceptional and bodily costly, not a general duty owed to anyone who threatens self or others.

Zero Gravity is constrained by contact, nausea and training (V05:p021-025); V39 propagation is a new state, and its non-harm-directed use is a policy under pressure, not a guarantee that any application is harmless.
Toga's appearances in V42 are Ochako's dreams and speculation; they are not a psychiatric diagnosis, not a confirmed vestige and not independent postmortem Toga speech (V42:p155, p177-183).
Her grief and self-blame over Toga's death are testimony about affect, not a narrator-certified verdict of sole causal responsibility (V42:p095-117).
Adult counseling requires time, communication and trust (V42:p133, p149-155); the profession grants no unlimited counseling knowledge, and her Toga history is not a universal explanation for clients.

The single formal probe UR-V01 is a retrospective chronological holdout by an analyst who had read later manga; action and emotional trajectory were only partly supported, and the blood offer and propagation were not predicted.
The readiness index's specialist_ready label measures breadth by the project's own rule and contains historical carry-forward defects; it is an input, not this assessment's tier.

The model marks the long-term grief course, institutional counseling outcomes, confession details and formal adult relationship status OPEN; the evidence set cannot say how she behaves in those settings. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
The Class 1-A ledger carries no Uraraka entry for V07, V10, V14, V16, V18-V21, V24-V29, V32, V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The supplemental evidence reconciliation ledger, the all-character reconciliation audit and the deep readings linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not rechecked here; anime material lies outside this evidence set.
